Author: Shin Devlin
Message:
v2.0.16: on-chain Telegram verification — no echo, no off-chain signatures

Linking Telegram to HONE now requires posting the challenge on-chain:
1. /link username → bot sends challenge code
2. User posts challenge via API: POST /api/user/verify-telegram
3. Transaction recorded on-chain (type: 'verification')
4. Bot polls and detects the on-chain proof → links account

The on-chain transaction IS the proof of ownership. No private keys
touch Telegram. The verification is permanent, auditable, on-chain.

- Removed echo-back and off-chain signature methods entirely
- Added 'verification' transaction type
- Both bots poll for on-chain completion
- API endpoint requires JWT auth (proves account access)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
